mapper.sql: PARTNER_CD, PARTNER_NM, ADAPTER_CD, CSS_ENGINE, PRODUCTS, TIMEOUT_MS, MARGIN_MS, ALLOW_IPS, SECRET_REF, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_LNK_PARTNER ORDER BY USE_YN DESC, PARTNER_CD
SELECT CSS_PRODUCT, PRODUCT_CD, PRODUCT_NM, ADMIN_LIST, USE_YN FROM TB_LNK_PRODUCT WHERE CSS_PRODUCT = #{cssProduct}
SELECT CSS_PRODUCT, PRODUCT_CD, PRODUCT_NM, ADMIN_LIST, USE_YN FROM TB_LNK_PRODUCT ORDER BY CSS_PRODUCT
SELECT OUTER_PRD_CD FROM TB_LNK_PARTNER_PRD WHERE PARTNER_CD = #{partnerCd} AND CSS_PRODUCT = #{cssProduct}
SELECT PARTNER_CD, INNER_CD, OUTER_CD, OUTER_MSG FROM TB_LNK_CODE_MAP WHERE PARTNER_CD = #{partnerCd} AND INNER_CD = #{innerCd}
SELECT PARTNER_CD, INNER_CD, OUTER_CD, OUTER_MSG FROM TB_LNK_CODE_MAP WHERE PARTNER_CD = #{partnerCd} ORDER BY INNER_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LNK_LIMIT_REQ (LNK_REQ_NO, PARTNER_CD, PARTNER_REQ_NO, CSS_PRODUCT, CI_HASH, CUST_NM_MASK, ANNUAL_INCOME, STATUS, CLIENT_IP, REQ_AT) VALUES (#{lnkReqNo}, #{partnerCd}, #{partnerReqNo}, #{cssProduct}, #{ciHash}, #{custNmMask}, #{annualIncome}, #{status}, #{clientIp}, #{reqAt})
mapper.sql: r.LNK_REQ_NO, r.PARTNER_CD, r.PARTNER_REQ_NO, r.CSS_PRODUCT, r.CI_HASH, r.CUST_NM_MASK, r.ANNUAL_INCOME, r.CSS_ENGINE, r.STATUS, r.RESULT_CD, r.OUTER_CD, r.LIMIT_AMT, r.RATE_BP, r.CSS_TX_NO, r.CSS_MS, r.TOTAL_MS, r.SHADOW_RESULT, r.RES_BODY, r.CLIENT_IP, r.REQ_AT, r.RES_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_LNK_LIMIT_REQ r WHERE r.PARTNER_CD = #{partnerCd} AND r.PARTNER_REQ_NO = #{partnerReqNo}

SELECT p.PARTNER_CD, p.PARTNER_NM, p.TIMEOUT_MS, COUNT(r.LNK_REQ_NO) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN r.RESULT_CD = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS APPROVED, SUM(CASE WHEN r.RESULT_CD = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REJECTED, SUM(CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FAILED, SUM(CASE WHEN r.RESULT_CD = 'TIMEOUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TIMEOUTS, CAST(AVG(r.TOTAL_MS) AS INT) AS AVG_MS, MAX(r.TOTAL_MS) AS MAX_MS, SUM(CASE WHEN r.TOTAL_MS > p.TIMEOUT_MS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OVER_TIMEOUT FROM TB_LNK_PARTNER p LEFT JOIN TB_LNK_LIMIT_REQ r ON r.PARTNER_CD = p.PARTNER_CD AND r.REQ_AT >= #{since} GROUP BY p.PARTNER_CD, p.PARTNER_NM, p.TIMEOUT_MS ORDER BY p.PARTNER_CD
